negative_binomial_numerical_correction.reason: The previous negative-binomial log mass suffered cancellation near the Poisson limit. The revised local likelihood and derivatives use log1p and an analytic limit. The model, bounds, starts, exact nested candidates and selection rule are retained.

original_printed_forecast_source.target_caveat: The original PDF describes magnitude >7 on the Richter scale. Its original query is unavailable, so target definitions and catalogue vintages may differ.

settings.scope: Exploratory analysis using previously seen outcomes and constraints fixed before these fits
settings.fit: Constrained conditional likelihood with constant-weight iid Gaussian allocations
settings.forecast: Conditional mean, with no clipping and no parameter-uncertainty integration

training.response_years: Second through final training year for each window

optimizer.selection: Successful finite optimizer candidates and exact nested candidate, by training likelihood

settings.nb2_numerics: Integer log mass using log1p and analytic derivatives, with the exact Poisson candidate at zero dispersion
